content: Restart-policy decision (planned, NOT yet implemented): align ALL units to Chimera's restart semantics — dinit compiled/built with --default-auto-restart=on-failure equivalent per-unit: dbus-activated on-demand daemons get restart=on-failure (crash-only restart, clean idle exit = unit stops until next dbus activation); boot-enabled long-running daemons keep smooth-recovery=true + restart=on-failure; one-shots stay restart=false. Alpine's stock dinit build defaults restart=ALWAYS (upstream configure default) — that is WHY idle-exit daemons loop. Evidence: systemd Restart= default=no; upstream polkit unit has NO Restart=; upower/TLP use Restart=on-failure; Chimera dinit template.py --default-auto-restart=on-failure; Artix elogind smooth-recovery=true + dbus smooth-recovery=no. Also: Alpine dinit has NO explicit default-auto-restart in APKBUILD (community/dinit prepare() runs plain configure). Full sweep of all units to be executed in a dedicated round; signon-ui churn (smooth-recovery=true + restart=always default = 42 restarts/20min proven) is the motivating case.

Restart-policy sweep EXECUTED (decision round + research): 144 unit files in 108 packages edited in aports — boot/session long-running daemons = smooth-recovery=true kept + restart=on-failure explicit; dbus-activated on-demand (idle-exit capable: signon-ui x2, fwupd, cups-pk-helper, secretprompter + the smooth=false geoclue/fprintd/kauth/EDS/GNOME apps class) = restart=on-failure + smooth-recovery=false; one-shots restart=false verified; getty restart=true special; dms.user FLIPPED to smooth=false (latent greeter-loop bug: its greeter-guard clean exit respawned DMS forever — harness autologin never exposed it). Root cause of churn: Alpine dinit builds STOCK = restart=ALWAYS (upstream configure default, no --default-auto-restart flag) — every unit without explicit restart restarted on clean exits too. systemd default=no; Chimera builds on-failure; upstream polkit no Restart=; upower/TLP on-failure. aports CI: 6 failed runs before green — DMS upstream RENAMED (DankMaterialShell -> duxlabs-dev/dux-shell + dank-qml-common -> dux-qml-common, v1.6.2 re-published) — sources repinned bytes-identical; lesson: tag archives NOT immutable, pin by commit. NEW product bug in backlog: xdg-desktop-portal-dinit runs the WRONG binary (permission-store instead of portal frontend). Validated: niriWayle 2026-11-08T15-57-09Z 118/118 ALL PASS (log_errors clean).

dinit restart-policy principle (FeralOS house rule now): dbus-activated on-demand daemons (idle-exit by design) = restart=on-failure + smooth-recovery=false — the next dbus call IS their restart mechanism; smooth-recovery=true + Alpine's stock restart=always default = infinite restart loop on clean exits (restart limiter 3/10s never catches slow 30s cycles). Boot-enabled resident daemons = smooth-recovery=true + restart=on-failure (crash-only; smooth handles state-preserving quick restart). dinit upstream configure default = restart ALWAYS — always set restart EXPLICITLY. Also: unit source-file renames need sha512sums regenerated IN source= order; upstream GitHub tag archives are immutable-UNRELIABLE (repos get renamed/re-published — DankMaterialShell -> dux-shell live case); pin by commit.

Source-pinning policy FINAL: every aports GitHub source pins to a TAG archive (refs/tags/), NEVER a commit archive — sha512 = integrity guard, tag = version contract; a checksum failure after an upstream tag re-publish IS the signal to review + port the fix (commit pins would silently keep old bytes forever). Executed: dms-shell r6 reverted to dux-shell v1.6.2 (re-fetch sum == the originally validated 7ccb2361; tag bytes unchanged) + dux-qml-common v1.6.0 (commit 26396ce contained; delta = one trivial VERSION bump; sum b589592); feralos-dbus-audit r6 → feralos tag dbus-audit-0.1.0 (cut + pushed at commit 3dd71ec; archive content == commit archive, diff -r rc 0; sum e1c39f20). signon-ui lifecycle facts (live-proven, run 2026-11-08T02-43-22Z disk): /usr/bin/signon-ui exits CLEANLY (RC=0) after exactly 30s by design (QtWebEngine init then idle exit — foreground run proof, no crash markers, dmesg clean); smooth-recovery=true + Alpine stock dinit restart=always = infinite 30s restart loop with ZERO dbus clients (42 restarts/20min measured); post-sweep live proof: one activation -> start -> 30s -> exit 0 -> unit STAYS STOPPED, zero restarts (dbus-monitor: NameLost with no new NameAcquired). WHY INSTALLED: extraPackages [okular] -> okular-common -> purpose (KF6) -> kaccounts-integration -> signon-ui+signond -> audit installs the units. GREETER: zero mechanism (no signon refs in greetd/regreet configs, zero spontaneous activations in 180s idle watch, greeter logs show only infra) — the real-hw regreet slowdown has NO identified signon-ui mechanism; user will test on own VM. GOTCHA: dbus.log appends across boots (old-boot pids masquerade as current activity when read naively); busybox pgrep -x misses signon-ui (use -f).

dbus-audit stays IN the feralos repo (user question, no separate repo): it enforces the installer's ADR-010 contract, runs at chroot step 8a, mirrors the harness dbus_activation_migration enumeration, and every convention change (R1b, FHS, trap-fallback) touched audit+installer+harness in the SAME commit — a separate repo would double the sync burden. Cost accepted: every audit change needs a feralos tag (dbus-audit-0.1.0 cut; future dbus-audit-<pkgver> tags before aports bumps). Split only if it ever becomes a standalone tool for other dinit distros.

Source pinning policy FINAL (user): all GitHub sources pin to TAG archives — NEVER commit archives. Rationale: upstream re-publishes a tag to fix a bug/CVE -> our sha512 check FAILS = the signal to review and port the fix; commit pins hide upstream fixes forever. sha512 = integrity guard, tag = version contract. Implemented: dms-shell r6 + feralos-dbus-audit r6 reverted to tags (dbus-audit-0.1.0 tag cut on feralos repo), full inventory 17 sources/16 packages all refs/tags/, rule documented in aports README 'Source pinning policy' + feralos AGENTS.md + docs/aports-pinning.md.

abuild postcheck rejects uncompressed man pages: gzip -9 them in package() (repo pattern: veila). Also the first sha512sums line must not start with a space — busybox sha512sum -c on abuild 3.15 rejects leading whitespace.

Harness live-activation check made honest-skip.
Alpine firewalld is built --without-iptables --without-ip6tables --without-ebtables (nftables-only); ip6tables/ebtables are virtual provides of the single iptables apk. Never list them for firewalld.

ursine capability Accountsservice probe is a false positive (checks for /run/dbus/system_bus_socket, not org.freedesktop.Accounts) — Users module errors cryptically if accountsservice missing. udisks2 probe is real (lsblk + udisksctl).
